gotchas: Credits come only from the HQ stipend (6/s, rules hq_stipend_credits_per_second) + 2500 at start; research is 800 each and 7->8 costs 3000 + 400 salvage, so the AI must bank. Salvage/ore pile up unused.
map_gen.gd has no class_name: preload it (const MapGenS). Referencing bare MapGen in ai_util broke compilation for every agent for one call.
Never index w.factions with anything but [fid] in sim/ai (static fairness regex). Use MapGenS.spawn_for for start cells.
Avoid preload cycles: ai_stage preloads ai_util, so ai_util must not preload ai_stage (bank_exempt lives in ai_util).
Content.role(..., stage) overrides only for the exact stage key ('7' / '9'); stage 8 = base roles.
Machine recon role == its infantry role (m_scout_crawler): _context does not divert it to ctx.recon.
ai_bench and soak time the AI by detaching w.ai_state during step(); otherwise the order matches world.step() (AI thinks after the systems).
